_why: 19 July 2026, CTR-12. Five students pressed Submit within the first minute,
before they had answered anything — each row shows 1-4 answers and a submit
timestamp of 10:30-10:31. The centre handed them the admit cards of KIDS Team
demo accounts and let them sit the paper properly on those IDs instead.
So the mark that belongs to each of these students is the one recorded against
the demo ID, not the accidental submission on their own ID. This file is the
record of that, and scripts/export-marks.ts applies it.
The accidental attempt is never deleted: it is carried through the export as
'Voided Own Marks' so the substitution can always be audited.
paperMismatch is computed, not declared here: the demo cards were handed out by
whoever was free rather than by class, so three of these students answered a
paper written for a different class. That is flagged in the export, loudly.
meritEligible is a DECISION, not a computation, which is why it is written out
per student rather than derived. Umar's call, 31 Jul 2026: the three who sat
another class's paper keep their marks and get their full private marksheet,
but stay off the public merit list — the mark is honestly theirs, the
comparison with their classmates is not, and a merit list has to be defensible
when a school asks how a Class X child was ranked on a Class IX paper.
No names here, deliberately: student names are personal data and live only in
the database (see src/lib/exam/schema.sql). Unique IDs and classes are enough
to say what happened, and both scripts read the names from Neon at run time.
